tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (9.4:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-deep-purple
tokens.usage: Intellectual depth, innovation, premium research. Used as text on `.header-title h1`, `.nav-link:hover`, `.section-title`. 10.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-neural-blue
tokens.usage: Trust, intelligence, computational precision. Used as text on `.nav-link.active`, `.metric-badge.info`, `.research-metric-value`; background on `.btn-primary`, `.filter-btn.active`, `.social-link:hover`. 3.3:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Clinical clarity, scientific objectivity. Used as background on `.header`, `.metric-card`, `.research-card`; text on `.header-logo`, `.btn-primary`, `.filter-btn.active`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-soft-gray
tokens.usage: Subtle backgrounds, reduced cognitive load. Used as background on `body`, `.nav-link:hover`, `.meta-tag`.

tokens.name: color-medium-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.header-title p`, `.section-subtitle`, `.metric-label`. 2.3:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.metric-badge.success`, `.change-positive`, `.score-high`. 2.3:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.metric-badge.warning`, `.score-medium`, `.rank-3`. 2.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: filter-btn-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: border on `.header`, `.metric-card`, `.research-card`; background on `.filter-btn:hover`.

tokens.name: change-negative-text
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: text on `.change-negative`, `.score-low`. 3.4:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.
